top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) credits a new modality whose mechanism was seen and not merely inferred: crystal structures of VHL with its substrate peptide and of degrader-bound ternary complexes explain cooperativity and linker selectivity in atomic terms, and the design rules have been reproduced across many groups and E3 ligases. The three names divide credit cleanly into concept (Crews, Deshaies, 2001), proof of concept and structure-guided drug-like chemistry (Ciulli). P003 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is mature and cleanly attributed but extends a bond class already honoured in 2010. P002 drops Ciulli, whose structural work is what answers my evidentiary concern, and pairs the remainder with base editing close to the 2020 CRISPR prize. No award ranks last because several candidates are mature and well attributed.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no connection to the candidates in the slate (Stockholm colleague of Peter Brzezinski only)
